pages.title: Dread in the Voice
pages.text: A cockatrice eye retains a trace of its deadly gaze. The pendant lends that power to a dragon's roar, deepening the dread it stirs in foes and the courage it gives allies. The roar's power also lasts longer.

pages.title: A Stronger Roar
pages.text: The roar grants Strength II and inflicts Weakness II, with both effects lasting 25%% longer. This works in either form. The pendant strengthens an existing roar; it does not grant the ability to young dragons.
